# Working in this repository

**Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before the first edit.** It is the contract every agent here works
under, it is short, and everything in it is something you cannot infer from the code.

Before you say a change is done: run `node plugin/scripts/check.mjs`, and the
project's test command. **A red gate is the work, not an obstacle to it.**

> In GitHub Copilot these rules are ENFORCED — see `.github/hooks/nexa.json`.
